# Joshua Werlein

> Full stack software engineer based in Mondovi, Wisconsin. Building production Android apps, serverless APIs, and modern web platforms with a focus on ownership from first commit to live deployment. Open to remote opportunities.

I hold a B.S. in Software Engineering from Western Governors University and work across the full stack — TypeScript and React on the frontend, Cloudflare Workers with D1, KV, and R2 for edge platforms, and Java with Spring Boot for backend services. I also ship native Android via Kotlin.

## Featured Projects

- [Arkham Enterprises](https://www.arkhamsolar.com): Live production marketing and lead-gen site for a solar and construction company. React SPA (React Router, Framer Motion) served from a Cloudflare Worker that also handles `/api/*` form submissions. Contact and quote-request forms send email via the Resend API with honeypot spam protection. SEO handled via react-helmet-async for per-page metadata. Source: [github.com/joshua-werlein/arkham-solar](https://github.com/joshua-werlein/arkham-solar).

- [Best By Manager](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.joshuawerlein.bestbymanager): Kiosk-style Android app for tracking product expiration dates in retail and food-service environments. Published to Google Play through a full release lifecycle: closed beta, staged rollout, v2.0.0 production. Offline-first Room (SQLite) database, ZXing barcode scanner integrated with the Open Food Facts API, three-tier permission model (Owner biometric, Admin PIN, Employee) with bcrypt credential storage, AlarmManager expiration notifications with configurable lead-time, Jetpack components throughout (ViewModel, LiveData, Navigation, RecyclerView).

- [KIL Construction](https://kilcon.work): Live production full-stack content platform for a construction company. Cloudflare Workers serverless backend with an Astro frontend (islands architecture), Cloudflare R2 object storage with custom signed-URL access, signed cookie session admin authentication (no third-party auth dependency), Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA plus in-Worker IP rate limiting on all public endpoints. Custom admin API for upload, rename, and delete operations behind session-gated middleware.

- [Friends of Lake Henry](https://friendsoflakehenry.com): Live production web platform for a nonprofit lake association. Same Cloudflare Workers + Astro secure architecture as KIL Construction, adapted for a non-technical admin audience. Delivers donation workflows with external payment integration, admin-managed event calendar, and a photo gallery backed by Cloudflare R2. Accessibility-first frontend designed for non-technical board members to manage content directly.
